components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #000; border: 0; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: background-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glyph Button
components.description: 44px round glyph with label, used in the reel action rail.
components.css: .ds-glyph { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: 0; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-glyph-c { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transition: background-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-glyph:hover .ds-glyph-c { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-glyph:active .ds-glyph-c { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-glyph:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-glyph-l { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.8); }

components.name: Pill Strip
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #b9b9c0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; transition: color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-pill:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-pill-on { background: #fff; color: #000; border-color: #fff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-reel { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 420px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; color: #fff; } .ds-reel-field { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 75% 8%, color-mix(in oklab, #9aa5b8 46%, #000) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, #9aa5b8 18%, #000) 46%, #000 82%), linear-gradient(to top, #000 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.88) 26%, transparent 70%); } .ds-reel-cap { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 0 84px 24px 20px; } .ds-reel-cap h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 0.98; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-reel-cap p { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-live i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e10600; }

narrative.overview: PitStopHub is a vertical media feed for motorsport. A black stage holds one race at a time: the category tints only the backdrop, the race title sits at the bottom left in heavy Archivo, and a rail of four round glyphs sits at the right. White is the only interface colour; red is reserved for next start, live and following; data freshness is carried by form (solid, dashed, half), not colour.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground, neutral panels with no blue or wine cast.
White as the interface colour; red reserved.
One family (Archivo), heavy weights for titles, minimum text size 12px.
Round controls (pills and 44px glyphs), large-radius panels.
Depth by tonal layering and hairlines; no decorative shadows.
Category colour lives in the media field only.

rules.name: The Reserved Red Rule
rules.body: Red means next start, live, or following. If a red element is none of those, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Field Only Rule
rules.body: Category hues colour the backdrop and nothing else: no text, buttons, borders or chart series.

rules.name: The Positive Only Rule
rules.body: Green appears only for a positive delta.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. No second display face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case. Tracking on labels stays at 0.01em.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that lines up uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Panels separate from the stage by step and hairline, not by shadow.

dos: Do use white for every interactive emphasis and reserve #e10600 for next start, live and following.
Do use signal (#ff5a4f) if red must be text.
Do show data freshness with the state mark shape (solid, dashed, half), with its text name beside it.
Do keep controls at least 44px and text at least 12px (0.75rem).
Do use tabular numerals for aligned numbers and sentence case for labels.
Do tint only the media field with the category hue; keep F1 steel (#9aa5b8).
Do keep motion between 150 and 250ms with exponential ease-out, and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't use a coloured border-left stripe on rows or cards.
Don't use red as a series, category or chart tone, or any hue as a text colour.
Don't add a second type family or text under 12px.
Don't colour interface chrome with category or team hues; team colours are thin data marks only.
